3.t: Does man think We shall not put his bones back together?

4.t: In fact, We can reshape his very fingertips.

5.t: Yet man wants to deny what is ahead of him:

6.t: he says, ‘So, when will this Day of Resurrection be?’

9.t: when the sun and the moon are brought together,

10.t: on that Day man will say, ‘Where can I escape?’

12.t: they will all return to your Lord on that Day.

13.t: On that Day, man will be told what he put first and what he put last.

14.t: Truly, man is a clear witness against himself,

15.t: despite all the excuses he may put forward.

16.t: [Prophet], do not rush your tongue in an attempt to hasten [your memorization of] the Revelation:

17.t: We shall make sure of its safe collection and recitation.

18.t: When We have recited it, repeat the recitation

19.t: and We shall make it clear.

20.t: Truly you [people] love this fleeting world

21.t: and neglect the life to come.

22.t: On that Day there will be radiant faces,

24.t: and on that Day there will be the sad and despairing faces

25.t: of those who realize that a great calamity is about to befall them.

26.t: Truly, when the soul reaches the collarbone;

27.t: when it is said, ‘Could any charm-healer save him now?’;

28.t: when he knows it is the final parting;

29.t: when his legs are brought together:

30.t: on that day he will be driven towards your Lord.

32.t: but denied the truth and turned away,

33.t: walking back to his people with a conceited swagger.

34.t: Closer and closer it comes to you.

36.t: Does man think he will be left alone?

37.t: Was he not just a drop of spilt-out sperm,

38.t: which became a clinging form, which God shaped in due proportion,

39.t: fashioning from it the two sexes, male and female?

40.t: Does He who can do this not have the power to bring the dead back to life?
